name: Equipment registrar
design: Broad middle-aged male with golden leopard-spotted hide, square cranium, blunt mandibles and medium dreadlocks with three plain bronze cuffs. Charcoal leather apron over ochre rolled-sleeve tunic, reinforced civilian belt, bare muscular forearms. Holds a CLOSED compact biomask in one hand at hip for equipment registration and a thin inspection tablet in other, neither worn nor fighting stance.
